appDescription: Reports highway incidents hands-free with precise kilometer milepost coordinates and alerts approaching vehicles to prevent secondary collisions.

function.name: REPORT_HIGHWAY_INCIDENT
function.description: Captures the current highway kilometer milepost immediately and submits a hands-free incident report.

lane_number.description: Blocked highway lane identifier reported by the driver.

incident_summary.description: Short summary of the observed road hazard or collision.

function.name: CHECK_AHEAD_HAZARDS
function.description: Displays verified secondary-collision hazard alerts ahead on the active highway route.

lookahead_km.description: Forward lookahead distance in kilometers along the current route.
